chant: ॥ ॐ नमः शिवाय • ॐ नमो भगवते वासुदेवाय • ॐ सूर्याय नमः ॥
title: Daily Vedic Panchang
subtitle: Sacred celestial calculations, Auspicious Muhurats, Choghadiya & Daily Panchanga computed with Vedic precision
panchangamDesc: The five foundational pillars of Vedic timekeeping aligning mortal actions with cosmic rhythms
shubhMuhuratDesc: Favorable planetary windows for commencing sacred rituals, travels, investments, and ceremonies
ashubhKaalDesc: Times governed by malefic energies where starting new auspicious ventures is traditionally avoided
brahmaMuhurtaDesc: Most auspicious pre-dawn window for meditation, prayer, and deep spiritual awakening
abhijitMuhurtaDesc: Auspicious 8th Muhurta of the day blessed by Lord Vishnu, eradicating all doshas
amritKaalDesc: Nectar period best suited for healing, coronation, and sacred ventures
godhuliMuhurtaDesc: Sacred twilight period ideal for evening Sandhya, lighting Diyas, and Lakshmi worship
vijayaMuhurtaDesc: Auspicious afternoon window guaranteeing triumph and victory in ventures
rahuKaalDesc: Period ruled by shadowy Rahu; avoided for new investments and departures
yamagandaDesc: Period governed by Yama; strictly avoided for crucial initial undertakings
gulikaKaalDesc: Period ruled by Saturn's son Gulika; actions performed tend to repeat
durMuhurtaDesc: Inauspicious window during the day to be sidestepped for sacred works
varjyamDesc: Inauspicious Nakshatra-dependent interval unsuitable for auspicious start
choghadiyaDesc: Traditional 8-period division of day and night to identify instant auspiciousness for daily activities
navagrahaDesc: Precise sidereal (Nirayana) positions of all nine celestial bodies at this auspicious moment
dishaShoolaDesc: Traditional direction to avoid embarking upon long travels on this day of the week
remedyDesc: If travel is unavoidable, consume curds, jaggery, or betel leaf and chant the Gayatri Mantra before departure
festivalsDesc: Upcoming sacred fasts, Ekadashi, Purnima, and divine festivals celebrated at the temple
guidanceDesc: Sacred deeds, mantras, and seva recommended at Shri Gaurishankar Baikunthnath Dham
